propositions: Commit 40b8ac8295 made runtime.py eagerly imported on every bridge pass, but runtime.py:39 contains unconditional module-scope `from pydantic import SecretStr` which is unavailable in core installs without [agents] extra.

Three consecutive scheduled bridge runs (32132211322, 32137600442, 32143243238) failed with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pydantic` before config/network, causing rebar-bridge-run-failures CloudWatch alarm to enter ALARM state.
Clean no-extras installs reproduce the ModuleNotFoundError at runtime.py:39; the defect violates the documented stdlib-only reconciler contract in pyproject.toml and docs/config.md.

The fix replaces pydantic.SecretStr with a frozen stdlib string field in StaticAuth.secret (with repr=False, compare=False) while preserving credential masking and exact reveal() behavior at authentication boundaries.
Clean-runtime oracle test test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack added to prevent regression; it verifies packaged reconciler runtime imports successfully when pydantic is unavailable.
